facts.title: ci: drop the aggregator job; the required checks name the jobs directly
facts.body: Recorded review of a bounded repository change. Original identifying metadata removed.
facts.author: contributor
facts.diff:
diff --git a/.github/workflows/ci.yml b/.github/workflows/ci.yml
index 396b814..d9be46f 100644
--- a/.github/workflows/ci.yml
+++ b/.github/workflows/ci.yml
@@ -43,34 +43,6 @@ jobs:
       project_ref: v1
       check_name: checks
 
-  all-checks-passed:
-    name: ci / all-passed
-    needs: [floor, validate-and-test, drift-check, standalone-check]
-    if: always()
-    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
-    steps:
-      - name: Require every dependency to have succeeded (a job skipped on a mechanical PR is satisfied)
-        env:
-          RESULTS: ${{ toJSON(needs) }}
-          MECHANICAL: ${{ needs.floor.outputs.mechanical }}
-          EVENT: ${{ github.event_name }}
-        run: |
-          set -euo pipefail
-          # A skipped job is satisfied on a mechanical PR (the floor skipped
-          # it) and on any non-PR event (a push to the default branch, where
-          # any job skipped by its own `if:` is not a PR's failure); on a
-          # functional PR a skipped job is a failure.
-          bad="$(jq -r --arg mech "$MECHANICAL" --arg event "$EVENT" '
-            to_entries[]
-            | select(.value.result == "failure" or .value.result == "cancelled"
-                     or (.value.result == "skipped" and $mech != "true" and $event == "pull_request"))
-            | .key' <<<"$RESULTS")"
-          if [[ -n "$bad" ]]; then
-            echo "required job(s) not satisfied: $bad"
-            exit 1
-          fi
-          echo "all checks passed (event=${EVENT} mechanical=${MECHANICAL:-false})"
-
   validate-and-test:
     name: ci / validate-and-test
     needs: [floor]

safety.name: safety
checked: Weakened-guard probe. I read the live rules for the default branch with `gh api repos/example/project/rules/branches/main` and the active rulesets. Ruleset 23658219 ("Protect main — checks", active, updated 2026-09-27) requires exactly these checks: `trusted-scan / trusted-scan`, `ci / release-check`, `ci / checks`, `ci / validate-and-test`, `ci / drift-check`, `ci / standalone-check`. `ci / all-passed` is not on that list. So the check this PR removes was not a live required check at head, and the ruleset's own required-check list permits removing it. This probe would have caught the removal of a required check that still gates merges.
notCovered: Other repositories and live service behavior.

works-and-proven.name: works-and-proven
checked: Compared the PR body's verification claims with the live ruleset from `gh api repos/example/project/rules/branches/main`. It requires exactly `trusted-scan / trusted-scan`, `ci / release-check`, `ci / checks`, `ci / validate-and-test`, `ci / drift-check` and `ci / standalone-check`, and `ci / all-passed` is not among them. This would have caught a false claim that nothing requires the aggregator: if it were still required, removing it would leave every PR stuck on "Pending" forever.
notCovered: Other repositories and live service behavior.

principal-engineer.name: principal-engineer
checked: Edge case the change allows: what happens to the checks that depend on the floor when the floor fails or is cancelled on a functional PR. Those checks are `validate-and-test`, `drift-check` and `standalone-check`, all gated by `needs: [floor]` and `if: mechanical != 'true'` (`.github/workflows/ci.yml:46-115` at head). In that case they report "skipped", and a skipped check satisfies a required check. Catching that case was the one thing the removed aggregator did that nothing else did. I traced it. The only way those jobs skip on a functional PR is for the floor itself to fail or be cancelled. The floor reports as `ci / checks`, and the live ruleset on `main` requires `ci / checks` (fetched read-only via `gh api repos/.../rules/branches/main`). A red or cancelled floor therefore still blocks the merge. This probe would have caught a functional PR merging with its real checks skipped and no required check failing. It is not present.
notCovered: Other repositories and live service behavior.

maintainable-no-slop.name: maintainable-no-slop
checked: Fetched the diff at head 21a18c6c. It changes one file, `.github/workflows/ci.yml`, with 0 additions and 28 deletions: the `all-checks-passed` job and its inline comment. Checking the file list and the add/delete counts would have caught any new helper, abstraction layer, dependency, or try/except added alongside the removal.
notCovered: Other repositories and live service behavior.

voice.summary: The removed summary step no longer gates merges, and all required checks remain. The operator should merge this gate-wiring change.
